rules.domain: unselected monitor/reference/latch startup and power loss
rules.conditions: Six-package candidate only. Coarse reference validity, control-power loss, retained charge, latch timing and sink release need whole-circuit evidence.
rules.refusal: Do not accept a complete permit or protection boundary from these partial component and draft-connectivity facts. Independent return integrity and physical qualification remain open.

rules.domain: precision-output feedback compensation and fault duty
rules.conditions: 100 ohm JACK-to-FB resistor and 1 nF DRIVE-to-FB capacitor in the OPA4197 precision-output cell. Manufacturer nominal values and ratings do not prove the assembled feedback loop or protection behavior.
rules.refusal: Do not accept populated-output stability, fault current/thermal duty, tolerance, temperature, layout parasitics or factory assembly from exact MPN capture and nominal model sweeps.

rules.conditions: Three load rails use1uF reservoirs and2.2kohm bleeders. Stored-energy discharge, effective capacitance, hot thermal margins and startup/fault sequencing depend on the complete unimplemented protection circuit.
rules.refusal: Do not accept rail discharge timing, safe partial-power behavior or thermal qualification from these nominal passive values and identity records.
